name: isi_1p65m
label: ISI 1.65 m Pfund telescope (truck-mounted siderostat + paraboloid)
sources: Hale et al. 2000, ApJ 537, 998 (the Infrared Spatial Interferometer): three 1.65 m Pfund-type telescopes on semi-trailers
ID Quantique ID230 brochure (June 2026): fibre input SMF or MMF 62.5 um
notes: throughput 0.2 = flat siderostat + paraboloid (two aluminium reflections, ~0.9) x atmosphere at 900-1550 nm (~0.9) x relay optics and fibre coupling into the ID230's 62.5 um multimode fibre in seeing (~0.25). Single-mode coupling would be a few per cent without adaptive optics.
The 1.65 m pupil smears binary fringes with periods below ~5 m (Capella at 1550 nm: lambda/rho = 5.7 m).
assumptions: throughput (fibre coupling to the ID230 MMF in seeing; the ISI's optics were built for 11 um)
